about_the_game:
When Lauren discovers financial discrepancies at her company, all signs point to her manipulative and morally bankrupt colleague, Vicki. But when Lauren confronts her, Vicki lashes out — threatening to seduce someone very close to Lauren in a calculated move to hurt her both professionally and personally.

Despite Lauren’s attempts to warn him about Vicki’s ulterior motives, he’s drawn in by the older woman’s charm and seductive tactics.

As Vicki’s influence grows, Lauren must make increasingly bold choices to hold his attention and keep him out of Vicki’s grasp. But every move she makes only pushes the limits of her own morality — and every time she gains ground, Vicki escalates her game.

Lauren now finds herself at a crossroads.

Will she fight fire with fire, risking her values and dignity to protect what matters most? Or will she step back and watch Vicki take control in a battle of lust, power, and seduction?

Guide Lauren through her journey of desire, deception, and personal conflict.

Experience a mature visual novel packed with high-quality animations, immersive choices, and branching storylines. Navigate themes of love, temptation, corruption, and NTR — all from a female protagonist’s point of view.

The game is an interactive visual novel with high-quality renders and animations, choices that will affect the captivating story, and multiple endings. The game also features corruption, and NTR themes, experienced from the perspective of a female protagonist.

Gameplay is structured around daily choices, where Lauren must walk a fine line between being emotionally supportive and dangerously alluring. Missteps could cost her everything… or awaken something unexpected inside her.

This game contains themes of corruption, netorare (NTR), and love from the perspective of a female protagonist.
